titleEn: Turn the AI agent on or off
planGate: package + AI credits + number; blocked without plan

ar: عايز المساعد الذكي يرد على العملاء
en: How do I turn on the AI agent?

steps: Choose persona, language, FAQ, promises, handoff time
Save and test from your phone
edgeCases: AI credits run out: the agent stops and hands the chat to staff
24-hour window closed: free text blocked (Meta 131047), only an approved template can be sent
No usable model / provider error = handoff (never silence or raw output)
Without a catalogue/Store it cannot search products
No active package: sends, agent and number connect answer 403 plan_required (no free plan, WA-NOFREE-1); a past_due package keeps replies/confirmations up to 7 days
Agent reports itself inactive if copy not configured (deploy issue)
assistantNote: the agent then messages customers by itself
